newsitem.title: UK: LME ALUMINIUM HOLDS GAINS IN LATE TRADING.
newsitem.headline: LME ALUMINIUM HOLDS GAINS IN LATE TRADING.

text.p: LME aluminium held its gains in late inter-office trading on Wednesday evening after motoring towards recent highs in afternoon trading.
At 1800 GMT, three months aluminium was indicated at $1,742/45, little changed from the afternoon kerb close of $1,741.50.
After the kerb, prices edged down to around $1,734/37, but found support and headed back towards Monday's high of $1,747.
Lead was indicated stronger at $612/14 versus a kerb close of $606, but the other metals were barely changed, including copper at $2,293/98.
